sentences.text:
Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
10.01.2025 jb.
jdt.
Crr 5278 of 2024 In Re: M/s Soril Infra Resources Limited & Ors. Mr. Sandipan Ganguly Mr. Ayan
Bhattacharya Mr. S. Mitra Mr. Saptarshi Mondal Mr. A. Sarkar .... For the Petitioners
The petitioners are engaged in a commercial relationship with the private opposite party from 2018.

They seek quashing of C.R. case no. 21911 of 2024 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate,
14 th Court, Calcutta.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that though the petitioners ordinarily reside beyond the jurisdiction of the Court, provision under Section 202 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has not been complied with before cognizance was taken.
The allegation against the petitioners is supply of defective material to the complainant which does not constitute an offence under Sections 406/420 of the Indian Penal Code.
The matter needs to be heard on merits.
The petitioners are directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let the matter appear under the heading 'Contested Application' in the monthly list of March, 2025.

Further proceedings of C.R. case no. 21911 of 2024 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate,
14th Court, Calcutta be stayed qua the petitioners till 31st March, 2025 or until further orders,
whichever is earlier.
Urgent certified website copy of the order, if applied for, be given to the parties on compliance of requisite formalities.
(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
CRR/5278/2024 on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152543523/
